## What this changes

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## How it was tested

List the commands you ran and what they reported, for example the affected `pytest` paths, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run test`, `npm run build` in the changed web-components package, or `swift test --package-path client`. Say what you exercised by hand, if anything.

## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit has a `Signed-off-by` line (`git commit -s`), as described in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [ ] The change is narrowly scoped and includes tests for changed behavior.
- [ ] No credentials, model weights, build output, local databases, logs, or generated web bundles are included.
- [ ] `python3 scripts/spelling/check_american_spelling.py` and `python3 scripts/check_literal_structural_colors.py` pass.
- [ ] A user-visible change has one plain-language bullet under `## Unreleased` in `CHANGELOG.md`, with no `<` or `&` characters.
